name: Alexandros IV of Macedon
role: Titular Macedonian king and posthumous son of Alexander the Great
summary: Alexander IV was recognized as king during his childhood, while regents and rival commanders exercised power. The reviewed sources preserve no political program or policy decisions attributable to him personally.

sources.title: Alexander IV of Macedon
sources.author: Wikipedia contributors
sources.usedFor: Minority, regency, captivity and death before personal rule.

sources.title: Library of History, Book XIX, chapter 105
sources.author: Diodorus Siculus; translated by Russel M. Geer
sources.usedFor: Ancient secondhand account of the settlement awaiting his majority and his murder.

sources.title: CM 4: Babylonian King List of the Hellenistic Period
sources.author: Babylonian scribal record; translation by R. J. van der Spek, Livius
sources.usedFor: Documentary attestation of titular kingship; no evidence of personal policy.
